title: 15-Minute StarForge Onboarding
description: Install StarForge, create a local wallet, scaffold a Soroban contract, and verify a deterministic offline simulation.

steps.title: Verify StarForge is installed (2 minutes)
steps.description: Run the CLI version command. This confirms the StarForge executable starts in your current shell.
steps.repair_hint: Install StarForge or build it with Cargo, ensure its executable is on PATH, then retry `starforge --version`.

steps.title: Create a local wallet (3 minutes)
steps.description: Create an unfunded wallet. Key generation and local storage do not require a network connection.
steps.repair_hint: Run `starforge wallet create onboarding` without `--fund`. If that name already exists, keep it and retry this checkpoint.

steps.title: Scaffold a Soroban contract (6 minutes)
steps.description: Generate the built-in hello-world contract template in the current working directory.
steps.repair_hint: Run the scaffold command from a writable directory where `onboarding-contract` does not already exist.

steps.title: Run a local simulation (4 minutes)
steps.description: Run the deterministic simple-counter scenario. It uses the local simulator and does not broadcast a transaction.
steps.repair_hint: List scenarios with `starforge network simulate list-scenarios`, then run `starforge network simulate run --scenario simple-counter` again.
